import type { HeaderContract } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
import { SurfaceController } from '../../controllers/surface-controller.js';
export declare class Header extends KrdsElement {
    static styles: import("lit").CSSResult[];
    static properties: {
        home: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        utilityItems: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        search: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        mainNavigation: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        actionLayout: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        sticky: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            reflect: boolean;
        };
        currentId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        mobileOpen: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        defaultMobileOpen: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        mobileTriggerId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        mobileTriggerLabel: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        navigationLabel: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        utilitiesOpen: {
            state: boolean;
        };
        narrow: {
            state: boolean;
        };
    };
    home: HeaderContract['home'];
    utilityItems: HeaderContract['utilityItems'];
    search: HeaderContract['search'];
    mainNavigation: HeaderContract['mainNavigation'];
    actionLayout: string;
    sticky: boolean;
    currentId: string;
    mobileOpen: boolean | undefined;
    defaultMobileOpen: boolean | undefined;
    mobileTriggerId: string;
    mobileTriggerLabel: string;
    navigationLabel: string;
    private utilitiesOpen;
    private narrow;
    private mobile;
    private media?;
    readonly surface: SurfaceController;
    constructor();
    get committedMobile(): boolean;
    private showMobile;
    private resize;
    connectedCallback(): void;
    disconnectedCallback(): void;
    private menu;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
